[cols="1,4,1,6", options="header"]
.Register Map
|===
| Address | Name | Access | Description
| 0x0 | INTR_STATE | RW a| -
| 0x4 | INTR_ENABLE | RW a| -
| 0x8 | INTR_TEST | W a| -
| 0xC | ALERT_TEST | W a| -
| 0x10 | CMD | W a| -
| 0x14 | CTRL | RW a| -
| 0x18 | STATUS | R a| -
| 0x1C | ERR_BITS | RW a| -
| 0x20 | FATAL_ALERT_CAUSE | R a| -
| 0x24 | INSN_CNT | RW a| -
| 0x28 | LOAD_CHECKSUM | RW a| -
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.INTR_STATE Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:1 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 0 | `done` | RW | 0x0 a| OTBN has completed the operation.
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.INTR_ENABLE Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:1 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 0 | `done` | RW | 0x0 a| Enable interrupt when !!INTR_STATE.done is set.
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.INTR_TEST Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:1 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 0 | `done` | W | 0x0 a| Write 1 to force !!INTR_STATE.done to 1.
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.ALERT_TEST Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:2 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 1 | `recov` | W | 0x0 a| Write 1 to trigger one alert event of this kind.
| 0 | `fatal` | W | 0x0 a| Write 1 to trigger one alert event of this kind.
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.CMD Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:8 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 7:0 | `cmd` | W | 0x0 a| The operation to perform.

\| Value \| Name          \| Description \|
\|:------\|:--------------\|:------------\|
\| 0xd8  \| EXECUTE       \| Starts the execution of the program stored in the instruction memory, starting at address zero. \|
\| 0xc3  \| SEC_WIPE_DMEM \| Securely removes all contents from the data memory. \|
\| 0x1e  \| SEC_WIPE_IMEM \| Securely removes all contents from the instruction  memory. \|
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.CTRL Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:1 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 0 | `software_errs_fatal` | RW | 0x0 a| Controls the reaction to software errors.

When set software errors produce fatal errors, rather than
recoverable errors.

Writes are ignored if OTBN is not idle.
|===

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
.STATUS Register
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:8 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 7:0 | `status` | R | 0x4 a| Indicates the current operational state OTBN is in.

All BUSY values represent an operation started by a write to the
!!CMD register.

\| Value \| Name               \| Description                                           \|
\|:------\|:-------------------\|:------------------------------------------------------\|
\| 0x00  \| IDLE               \| OTBN is idle: it is not performing any action.        \|
\| 0x01  \| BUSY_EXECUTE       \| OTBN is busy executing software.                      \|
\| 0x02  \| BUSY_SEC_WIPE_DMEM \| OTBN is busy securely wiping the data memory.         \|
\| 0x03  \| BUSY_SEC_WIPE_IMEM \| OTBN is busy securely wiping the instruction memory.  \|
\| 0x04  \| BUSY_SEC_WIPE_INT  \| OTBN is busy securely wiping the internal state.      \|
\| 0xFF  \| LOCKED             \| OTBN is locked as reaction to a fatal error, and must be reset to unlock it again. See also the section "Reaction to Fatal Errors". \|
|===

| 21 | `illegal_bus_access` | RW | 0x0 a| An `ILLEGAL_BUS_ACCESS` error was observed.
| 20 | `bad_internal_state` | RW | 0x0 a| A `BAD_INTERNAL_STATE` error was observed.
| 19 | `bus_intg_violation` | RW | 0x0 a| A `BUS_INTG_VIOLATION` error was observed.
| 18 | `reg_intg_violation` | RW | 0x0 a| A `REG_INTG_VIOLATION` error was observed.
| 17 | `dmem_intg_violation` | RW | 0x0 a| A `DMEM_INTG_VIOLATION` error was observed.
| 16 | `imem_intg_violation` | RW | 0x0 a| A `IMEM_INTG_VIOLATION` error was observed.
| 15:8 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 7 | `rnd_fips_chk_fail` | RW | 0x0 a| An `RND_FIPS_CHK_FAIL` error was observed.
| 6 | `rnd_rep_chk_fail` | RW | 0x0 a| An `RND_REP_CHK_FAIL` error was observed.
| 5 | `key_invalid` | RW | 0x0 a| A `KEY_INVALID` error was observed.
| 4 | `loop` | RW | 0x0 a| A `LOOP` error was observed.
| 3 | `illegal_insn` | RW | 0x0 a| An `ILLEGAL_INSN` error was observed.
| 2 | `call_stack` | RW | 0x0 a| A `CALL_STACK` error was observed.
| 1 | `bad_insn_addr` | RW | 0x0 a| A `BAD_INSN_ADDR` error was observed.
| 0 | `bad_data_addr` | RW | 0x0 a| A `BAD_DATA_ADDR` error was observed.
|===
